caseName: Laurel v. United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit
caseNameFull: Laurel v. United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Treating the motion for leave to file and the petition for writ of mandamus as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari granted. Order vacated and case remanded for further consideration in light of Bifulco v. United States, ante, p. 381.
